Here is Python code to calculate percentage increases for the provided funds and identify the lowest.

```python
# filename: compute_increase_initial.py
import pandas as pd

# Construct the dataset
data = [
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV_May_2019": 10.45, "NAV_May_2024": 12.10, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV_May_2019": 28.00, "NAV_May_2024": 33.60, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund", "Ticker": "FSEAX", "NAV_May_2019": 24.50, "NAV_May_2024": 30.87, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
]

# Create DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate percentage increase
df["Pct_Increase_%"] = ((df["NAV_May_2024"] - df["NAV_May_2019"]) / df["NAV_May_2019"]) * 100

# Sort and find minimum
df_sorted = df.sort_values("Pct_Increase_%")
min_row = df_sorted.iloc[0]

print("Percentage increases (May 2019 -> May 2024):")
for _, row in df_sorted.iterrows():
    print(f"{row['Ticker']}: {row['Pct_Increase_%']:.2f}%")

print("\nFund with lowest increase:")
print(f"{min_row['Fund Name']} ({min_row['Ticker']}) - {min_row['Pct_Increase_%']:.2f}% with {min_row['Transaction Fee']} transaction fees")
```
